tracking: ADR-0360 (lane E41): API-only under the lane brief rule 3; the fleet operations screens (per-group self-update, rollouts and their halt threshold over ADR-0350 device groups, one-line enrolment) are requested on #453 (Governed Designer)

gaps.GET /v1/endpoint-device-groups/:groupId/: reads a device group's self-update setting (off by default)
gaps.PUT /v1/endpoint-device-groups/:groupId/: turns a device group's self-update on (settings_relax step-up, audited) or off
gaps.GET /v1/discovery/sources/:sourceId/upda: lists a source's staged agent update rollouts with their declared lifecycle
gaps.POST /v1/discovery/sources/:sourceId/upd: creates a staged agent update rollout over ADR-0350 device groups (audited)
gaps.GET /v1/discovery/update-rollouts/:rollo: reads one rollout, its stages and the allowed next steps
gaps.POST /v1/discovery/update-rollouts/:roll: starts, advances, completes, pauses, resumes or aborts a rollout (guarded by the declared table; audited)
gaps.POST /v1/discovery/sources/:sourceId/one: issues a single-use, 15-minute enrolment token and the one line to paste as root (audited; the secret is shown once)
gaps.PUT /v1/discovery/update-rollouts/:rollo: sets a rollout's halt threshold within its bounds (tightening free, loosening a settings_relax step-up; audited)
